Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_temp NUMBER;
 tstcount number;
 szUnitId varchar2(15);

BEGIN

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;


:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:=null; --- This variable is referenced by the library
:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:=null;

IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id is not null then 
 If Length (:ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id)= 15 then
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='I';
 Elsif length (:ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id)= 7 then
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='C';

 if ltrim(:ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id,'0987654321') is not null then 
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='A';
 else
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='N';
 end if;
 Else
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_FORMAT(:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar,:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme,:ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id);

 :GLOBAL.unit_id:=szUnitId; -- This global value is used in the block property of unit test results
 
 Select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from donations where unit_id=szUnitId;
 if v_temp=0 then
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif v_temp=1 then
 select a.coll_date,b.last_name||' , '||b.first_name||' '||b.middle_name donor_name,
 b.date_of_birth,gender into 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_coll_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_name,:ctrl_blk_1.s_dob,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex from donations a,donors b where 
 a.unit_id=szUnitId and b.donor_id=a.donor_id;

 select count(*) into tstcount from unit_test_results where
 unit_id=szUnitId and coll_date=:ctrl_blk_1.s_coll_date and test_id in 
 (select test_id from valid_tests_don where
 view_level<=(select acc_priv from fcn_grp_priv where user_id=:banner.user_id and appl_id='DON'));

 if tstcount=0 then
 show_error('9188');
 check_package_failure;
 else 
 setup_blocks;
 end if;
 else
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_coll_date');
 end if;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields

 field_name = field_name1;

 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;

 r_chk := F_required;

exception

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE populate_rbc_antigens(pl_unit_id in varchar2,pl_group_id in varchar2,pl_block_name in varchar2) IS

 Cursor rbc_cur is select a.test_id,a.result_code from unit_test_results a, valid_tests_don b
 where a.test_id=b.test_id and b.antigen_group=pl_group_id and a.unit_id=pl_unit_id and
 b.antigen_flag='R'; 

 /* Cursor rbc_cur is select a.test_id,a.result_code from unit_test_results a, valid_tests b
 where a.test_id=b.test_id and a.unit_id=pl_unit_id; */

 v_block_test varchar2(20):= pl_block_name||'.'||'s_test_id';
 v_block_result varchar2(20):= pl_block_name||'.'||'s_result';
 
 v_test varchar2(10);
 v_result varchar2(10);

 result_rec unit_test_results%rowtype;
BEGIN

 if rbc_cur%isopen then
 close rbc_cur;
 end if;

 open rbc_cur;
 loop
 begin
 FETCH rbc_cur into v_test,v_result; 
 if rbc_cur%notfound then
 exit;
 end if; 

 copy(v_test,v_block_test); 
 copy(v_result,v_block_result); 

 create_record;
 end;
 end loop;
 close rbc_cur;
 delete_record;
END;

 pl_hla_b1 out varchar2,pl_hla_b2 out varchar2) IS

 b.antigen_flag='H' and b.test_id=a.test_id and a.unit_id=pl_unit_id order by
 substr(a.result_code,1,1);

 end if;

 if hla_cur%found then

 if hla_cur%found then

 set_block_property('ctrl_blk_1',update_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('ctrl_blk_1',insert_allowed,property_false);

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2, pl_donor_id in varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;
